content: Collection-game economies share a single currency with the main economy. Exploit vectors: capture rate manipulation (client-side RNG, formula bypass), duplicate farming loops (dupes -> soul gems -> resale), and item arbitrage between game drops and the global market. Counter-strategies from bot-economy literature: dynamic resource spawning, transaction/frequency limits calibrated to human behavior, economic honeypots (traceable items to identify bot networks), ML-based economic anomaly detection. Economy vocabulary: faucet vs sink, inflation/deflation, choke points, opportunity cost. Poketwo marketplace demonstrates the core risk: tradable collectibles with a global market create instant price-discovery arbitrage between game systems.
